limitations: Not a classification of singular fibers, polarizations, isomorphism types of special Jacobians, or all characteristic-five genus-two families. An older equivalent specialization may exist.
scientific_integrity: The smooth geometric fibers of the explicit characteristic-five genus-two pencil admit two elliptic quotients; exact Hasse factorizations classify 5-rank and a separate complete Cartier–Manin matrix classifies a-number and superspeciality. Self-review passed; independent audit not performed.
title: Complete \(p\)-rank and \(a\)-number stratification of an extremal genus-two fibration
